name: Messaging
description: Sends SMS, WhatsApp and email through Africa’s Talking, Twilio, the WhatsApp Business Cloud API or SMTP, behind an outbox with retries, idempotency keys and a dead-letter view.
author: SchoolPilot3 Team

settings.label: Provider
settings.description: Which provider the school sends through. The credentials for the selected provider come from the deployment configuration.

settings.label: Sender id
settings.description: The registered short code or alphanumeric sender id for SMS. A message may carry its own sender instead.

settings.label: Africa’s Talking base URL
settings.description: The Africa’s Talking API base URL.

settings.label: Delivery-report source allowlist
settings.description: Comma-separated source addresses a delivery report may come from. Africa’s Talking signs no delivery report; with no allowlist configured, every report is refused.

settings.label: Twilio account SID
settings.description: The Twilio account SID, which identifies the account the message is sent from.

settings.label: Twilio sender
settings.description: The Twilio number or channel address the school sends from.

settings.label: Twilio Messaging Service
settings.description: A Twilio Messaging Service to send through instead of a single number. Set this or the sender, not both.

settings.label: Twilio status callback URL
settings.description: The public URL Twilio posts status callbacks to. The X-Twilio-Signature covers this URL, so it must match exactly.

settings.label: WhatsApp phone number id
settings.description: The WhatsApp Business phone number id the messages are sent from.

settings.label: WhatsApp Graph API version
settings.description: The Graph API version the Cloud API calls use.

settings.label: WhatsApp default language
settings.description: The language code a WhatsApp template is sent in when the message names none.

settings.label: Email sender address
settings.description: The envelope sender and From address for email.

settings.label: Email sender name
settings.description: The display name on the From header.

settings.label: Message-ID domain
settings.description: The domain the generated Message-ID is anchored to. Defaults to the sender address’s domain.
